name: @javis-dog/crypto
description: JGR privacy classes L1/L2 (ADR-0018): project recovery key (JDK1, Crockford base32 + checksum), HKDF-SHA256 derivations per project slug, derived kid, L1 HMAC-SHA256 hashes per field, L2 payload v1 padded to 256 bytes and AES-256-GCM with the event AAD. WebCrypto only (Node 22 and browsers); keys are non-extractable CryptoKeys.
